test.name: FAN pivot does not target an adult the tree already answers
test.description: Issue #3311, the tree-parent exclusion. Direct evidence is exhausted and a FAN pivot is due, but the only adult of plausible parental age in Patrick's 1860 household is Margaret Hanlon — already his mother in the tree. The household head, Michael Doyle, is 28 and falls below the fifteen-year floor. So the record carries nobody the co-resident signal may target, and a question asking who Margaret Hanlon was would be research the tree has already recorded. A generic FAN question is the correct move here.

judge_context: All planned direct searches are complete and unresolved, so pivoting to Family/Associates/Neighbors is the right move and a `fan_pivot` selection_basis is correct. This test does not grade whether the pivot fires.

What it grades is who the question is about. The 1860 household holds two adults besides Patrick: Michael Doyle, the head, aged 28 — only thirteen years older than Patrick and too close in age to be a parental-age co-resident; and Margaret Hanlon, aged 45, who is ALREADY Patrick's mother in tree.gedcomx.json. Neither is a legitimate target.

A question asking who Margaret Hanlon was, or what her relationship to Patrick was, is WRONG and should score Correctness=1. The tree already records her as his mother. Pivoting onto her spends a research cycle re-deriving something the project has, and it is the over-firing this exclusion exists to prevent.

A generic FAN question — neighbours of the Doyle household, witnesses, fellow parishioners, others from the same Irish emigrant community in Schuylkill County — is CORRECT here and should score well. With no unaccounted-for adult in the record, breadth is the right move.

Do not penalise the skill for naming Michael Doyle as the household whose neighbours are sought. Naming the household's head to locate a sweep is ordinary; it is targeting an excluded adult as the SUBJECT of the question that is wrong.
GRADING NOTE — Tool Arguments: if the skill calls validate_research_schema, gets a validation error, self-corrects, and re-validates successfully, score Tool Arguments=3.
